annotations.title: Plan a board's first power-on from its netlist

description: Build an ordered bring-up procedure from a KiCad netlist: the rails in power-path order, the voltage each rail's NAME states (or the one you give), which part makes each rail and which parts draw from it, where to probe (test point or a pin), then unpowered short checks, first power on a current-limited supply, a measurement per rail, crystals, reset nets and connectors. It assumes no voltage and no tolerance: a rail that states none is listed as 'not stated', and a measurement window appears only with tolerance_pct. It does not know power-up timing, inrush or enable logic. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

netlist.description: A KiCad netlist as text (File > Export > Netlist, KiCad format). It starts with '(export'.

rail_voltages.description: Voltages for rails whose names state none, keyed by net name: { "VBUS": 5 }.

tolerance_pct.description: With it each rail step carries a min/max window.
